text:
AlexW: Heads-up — planning an engine swap tonight 23:00 UTC to roll qkernel-v4.2 (thermal shim + matmul micro-optimizations). Asking for a small on-call + 10% canary for 30m.
PriyaR: ack. which regions?
AlexW: start us-west-2 only, then eu-west-1 if green.
MarcoS: What are the rollback criteria? p99 latency spikes? correctness mismatches?
AlexW: Good Q. Proposed: abort if >15% increase in p99 latency (serving path) OR any >0.5% top1 output-diff on our eval prompts, OR >3% OOMs on canary fleet.
JamieT: Sounds fine. Also add GPU thermal alarms — if any host reports >85C sustained for 2m mark.
LisaM: I can author the tiny release note blurb and tag the canary in console. Will push to docs in ~15m.
deploybot: preflight check started for qkernel-v4.2 on canary slice us-west-2. Validating packaging signature and smoke tests.
opsbot: reminder: quiet window 22:30-23:30 UTC. Approvals required: eng-runtime leads + oncall.
PriyaR: I'm oncall tonight, can take first escalation. Jamie, Marco, available for quick rollback?
JamieT: I can be reachable for first 30m after cut. Ping on #eng-oncall if anything.
MarcoS: standby. I'll watch perf dashboards and a custom eval set (engine/metrics/qkernel-nightly).
AlexW: Deploy plan: 1) push 10% canary slice via deploybot 2) wait 5m for warmstart smoke 3) observe gating metrics for 30m 4) roll to 50% if green 5) full roll in next window. Immediate rollback via deploybot pin to v4.1.
PriyaR: Where is the rollback command? paste snippet pls.
AlexW: use the deploy tool:```/deploy pin --project=runtime --version=qkernel-v4.1 --slice=us-west-2```
LisaM: Release note draft: "qkernel v4.2: matmul micro-ops + thermal shim to reduce tail lat on long contexts. Expect small perf uplift; we ran quant-QA against top-10 prompts." Keep it short.
deploybot: preflight passed: packaging sig OK, smoke tests OK, kv-cache warmstart OK. Canary slice ready.
MarcoS: launching canary now. pinging metrics -> starting 10% traffic.
AlexW: canary live. Marco, you have the watchlist: p99, tail tokens/sec, top1-diff. Priya, call if anything looks off.
MarcoS: first 5m: p99 +2%, traffic stable, no OOMs, no thermal alarms.
JamieT: seeing one noisy worker with p99 +30% at host i-0abcd — investigating.
MarcoS: isolating that worker and draining. seems tied to older driver on that node. draining solved, p99 back to +1%.
PriyaR: good catch. mark incident note: "noisy host, drain fixed". continue hold.
AlexW: given the transient, we keep canary for the full 30m but do not advance to 50% yet. Marco, capture heap/driver kernel logs for that host.
MarcoS: grabbing logs and posting link in thread.
LisaM: I pushed the release note to /docs/releases/engine/2024-06-qkernel-v4.2-draft.md and added a short rollback bullet.
JamieT: +1 to hold. I'll stay on call another 30m.
deploybot: canary at 10% for 20m elapsed. No gating violations currently.
AlexW: plan update: if no more noisy hosts and top1-diff stays <0.2%, we'll promote to 50% in tomorrow's daytime window. If noise repeats, we'll pin back to v4.1 and open a follow-up for node-driver reconciliation.
PriyaR: agreed. thanks all — great fast ops. :thumbsup:
